name: ACP Lifecycle Guard
description: Validates ACP lifecycle reports and runs a durable, fenced report-delivery controller.

enforce.description: Cancel malformed lifecycle reports and block direct intermediate publication. Set false to classify and log only.

blockDirectIntermediateToolCalls.description: Block direct message-tool publication of ACP intermediate reports.

blockNonMainAcpLaunches.description: Block recognized ACP launch routes when the hook context agent id is not exactly 'main'.

ownerCheckpointReceiptMode.description: Owner-checkpoint delivery-receipt completeness. 'observe' logs a missing publication receipt at finalize; 'enforce' additionally requests a bounded finalize revise requiring one explicit messaging-tool send to the original conversation. Independent of 'enforce': that toggle never activates this guard.

maxIntermediateChars.description: Character ceiling for the ten-minute cadence report.

maxBoundaryReportChars.description: Character ceiling for start, correction-start, and completion reports.

enforce.label: Enforce
enforce.help: Turn off for a live message_sending cancellation smoke before activation.

ownerCheckpointReceiptMode.label: Owner checkpoint receipt mode
ownerCheckpointReceiptMode.help: Default 'observe' only logs a missing checkpoint publication. Switch to 'enforce' as a deliberate operator rollout after an observe-mode soak.
